evals.name: wait-for-text
evals.prompt: The wizard takes a variable time to show the second screen.
evals.expected_output: Polls the screen for the expected text with a deadline. Does NOT use a fixed sleep.

evals.name: exit-from-file
evals.prompt: An interactive program printed "EXIT=0" before failing.
evals.expected_output: Reads the exit code from the exit file. Never trusts a code printed on the screen.
